reason: The reviewed operator journey is substantially clearer: cohort navigation preserves context, the attention board separates submitted forms from canonical valid evidence, closure explains unfinished work and its irreversible consequence, and blocked-release diagnostics name actual rounds and missing requirements. Batch release keeps the full cohort authoritative despite filtering and bounds acknowledgement waits. The public capture has coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy, with cost and duration stated early and pending project proof disclosed honestly. However, the individually accessible release action retains an unbounded and ambiguous recovery path. That inconsistency at an irreversible operator action prevents my broad world-class agreement and warrants holding consequential release use until corrected. This is a source-based AI review, not observed operator success. Approved engagement proof, current workload facts, policy decisions and hosted acceptance remain missing; local test counts cannot resolve those limits.

findings.evidence: ReleaseButton calls useAction/runAction, which awaits authorizedFetch and response.json without a deadline. Pending clears only after settlement. A thrown response becomes generic "Could not release"; ReleaseButton refreshes only on success or a parsed released:true. The live dossier exposes this button for LOCKED decisions at src/app/admin/applications/[id]/page.tsx:552. The supplied lost/stalled release test mounts the batch-only harness, so its passing recovery assertion does not cover this individual path.
findings.userImpact: An operator releasing one recovered outcome can remain indefinitely at Releasing, or receive an apparent failure with stale LOCKED controls after the release committed but acknowledgement was lost. They lack the batch flow’s explicit unknown-result and current-state review guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Give individual release a full-body deadline, validated receipt and explicit unknown-outcome state; refresh/reconcile current decision state before permitting a fresh release attempt. Cover stalled bodies and commit-then-lost acknowledgements using the actual individual control.
